paragraphs.text: The House of Xarl was the royal family of Golthonor on ancient Corondor headed by Archmage Xarl Angel-Keeper .

The House of Xarl contains his many wives, including Eska , a handful of concubines, and countless children, grandchildren, and descendants, including Eskil . The House of Xarl crumbled after Xarl's death 346 years after the Serra Angel Trine was bound and made a fallen angel .
